concept: Review and integration: compassion as strength, not weakness
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across social risk, being present, and compassion toward someone who wronged you — which took the most strength?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real relationship where more compassion would help

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
